description:
Per the user's note during opi-y1y: with the Anthropic provider's API stabilized (octo-42f + opi-y1y landed), lift it out of octo_pi_ai so it has its own mix.exs, deps, tests, and a well-defined dependency on the core.

Scope:
- New app `apps/octo_pi_anthropic/` with `{:octo_pi_ai, in_umbrella: true}` dep and its own req/plug/jason deps.
- Move all `OctoPi.AI.Providers.Anthropic.*` modules to `OctoPi.Anthropic.*` (match the new app's root namespace).
- Core `OctoPi.AI.stream/3` dispatches via a providers registry in Application env; each provider app registers itself on start.
- Move Anthropic-specific tests + the FakeAnthropicPlug test helper. Keep generic tests (SSE, PartialJson, contract types) in core.
- Drop req/plug/bandit from octo_pi_ai's mix.exs once the Anthropic pieces are gone.
- `mix ai.demo` moves to the Anthropic app (it builds Claude Model structs).
- `config/runtime.exs` keychain config key name stays `:octo_pi_ai, :anthropic_keychain_reader`... actually move that to `:octo_pi_anthropic` namespace as part of the extraction.

DoD: mix check green, `mix ai.demo "ping"` still works end-to-end, both apps compile standalone.
title: Extract Anthropic provider into its own umbrella app (octo_pi_anthropic)
